# teams agent user update

Update an Agent 365 agentic user's name, usage location, license, and/or UPN

## Usage

```
teams agent user update [userIdOrUpn] [options]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `userIdOrUpn` | [OPTIONAL] Agentic user’s object ID or UPN to update. Overrides agent.generated.config.json when given; required if no local config exists. | No |

## Options

| Flag | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `--name <name>` | [OPTIONAL] New display name for the agentic user |
| `--usage-location <code>` | [OPTIONAL] Two-letter country code for the agentic user’s usage location (e.g. US) |
| `--license <skuId>` | [OPTIONAL] License SKU ID or part number to assign |
| `--no-license` | [OPTIONAL] Remove all currently assigned licenses |
| `--upn <value>` | [OPTIONAL] New user principal name for the agentic user (must use a verified domain in the tenant) |
| `--json` | [OPTIONAL] Output as JSON |
